responsibility: This implementation module bridges GNU Modula-2 environment access to the host libc getenv and putenv functions using raw character arrays. It copies a found environment value into a caller-supplied nul-terminated buffer and reports success, or forwards a complete variable definition string to putenv, making it the low-level ARRAY OF CHAR companion to the String-based SEnvironment wrapper.
same_name_distinction: This file is the implementation of the Environment interface, containing the direct libc getenv/putenv calls and buffer-copying logic that realize the ARRAY OF CHAR API declared in Environment.def.
